methods.name: public static String decode(byte[] in, char[] out, int offset, int utfSize) throws UTFDataFormatException
methods.comment:
* Decodes a byte array containing modified UTF-8 bytes into a string. * *

Note that although this method decodes the (supposedly impossible) zero byte to U+0000, * that's what the RI does too.

methods.name: public static long countBytes(String s, boolean shortLength) throws UTFDataFormatException
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of bytes the modified UTF-8 representation of 's' would take. Note
     * that this is just the space for the bytes representing the characters, not the length
     * which precedes those bytes, because different callers represent the length differently,
     * as two, four, or even eight bytes. If {@code shortLength} is true, we'll throw an
     * exception if the string is too long for its length to be represented by a short.

methods.name: public static void encode(byte[] dst, int offset, String s)
methods.comment: * Encodes the modified UTF-8 bytes corresponding to string {@code s} into the * byte array {@code dst}, starting at the given {@code offset}.
